claim_boundary: A positive v4.8 result would show that learning/inherited controller dynamics contribute to the v4.7 E1-like signal beyond a frozen random recurrent reservoir. It would still not establish cumulative knowledge or spontaneous science.
decision_rule: Selected-representation excess is supported only if the full condition has positive mean carrier-fraction excess and the paired one-sided sign test across non-tied histories is <= 0.05.
